title: Rental Revolution, Transit Plus and Minuses Made Headlines in September
summary: September, 2026 brought a growing focus on rental housing, changes to transit service, and continued progress on Toronto’s skyline. Proposals in Etobicoke, Markham, and Richmond Hill highlighted the continued turn from condos to purpose-built rentals, while plans in Ajax and at Yonge and St Clair pointed to denser neighbourhoods across the region. Operational improvements on Finch West Line 6, and the Scarborough Busway’s opening were good news, but GO service cuts were concerning on both the Front Page and in Forum discussions.
